draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.84, the 3rd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 18 at RB. He went 8th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Josh Jacobs. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (81st percentile). College production: 1,580 rushing yards in 2022, 4th of 18 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 51 career games and 50 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (16 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: scrimmage yards 2,298 (100th percentile), approximate value 16 (98th percentile), receptions 79 (98th percentile). Weak spots: fumbles lost 3 (3rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 running back who played: 2,298 scrimmage yards against a median of 530, above the norm.
